lead103_w11_drop_beat_posts_read_correla.classification_evidence: 12 games, 2 block looks this week in one family (market, beat_posts); a full-versus-ablated agreement has no wrong-sign direction to resolve and no positive control or split-half reliability is measured for the block effect, so nothing closes.
lead103_w11_drop_beat_posts_read_correla.description: Correlation across 12 Week 11 games not yet kicked off between the full LEAD-99 deadline read (mean of 4 reads) and the read with the beat_posts block removed (mean of 3 reads), logit scale, frozen prompt and model; bootstrap 95 percent interval over games. Lower means the block moves the read more.
lead103_w11_drop_beat_posts_read_correla.notes: Week 11 deadline packet 2026-week-11-deadline-20261119T230145Z, IND_HOU excluded. Ablations under artifacts/lead99_llm_read/ablations/ (3 valid). Mean absolute logit shift 0.036 [0.019, 0.062]; null mean shift 0.032 at noise 0.052, ratio 1.14 [0.60, 1.94], matched-null percentile 0.753; at this week's measured pooled read SD 0.030, ratio 2.01 [1.05, 3.41], percentile 1.000. Signed shift +0.030 [+0.008, +0.058], P+ 0.999 (dropping beat posts moves reads toward the home side). Largest: PIT_PHI +0.157. Week 9 single-read look: mean shift 0.072.
lead103_w11_drop_beat_posts_read_correla.plain_summary: Reruns the written game read with one kind of information left out, to see which kind actually moves the read and could become a cheaper measured input.
